label: Weapon
hint: Upgrades change it in place. Your equipped one goes first.

label: Chest gear
hint: Shirts, jackets, armor. Your worn one goes first.

label: Sharp
hint: Nails, tacks, broken glass, razor blades.

label: Bind
hint: Tape, glue, rope, zip ties. Holds the rest together.

label: Haft
hint: Something long to put a point on.

label: Blade
hint: A short edge: razor blades, knives.

label: Cord
hint: Rope, chain, anything you can tie a weight to.

label: Pouch
hint: Something you can put things in.

label: Fuel
hint: Burns, or sprays and then burns.

label: Wick
hint: Something to stuff in a bottle and light.

label: Echo's parts
hint: Echo builds its modules from these. See Echo's modules below.
